newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman Savings, Commercial Bank to vote on merger.
newsitem.headline: Oman Savings, Commercial Bank to vote on merger.

text.p: Shareholders of the Oman Savings and Finance Bank and the Commercial Bank of Oman (CBO) will vote on the banks' merger at a meeting on May 10, the banks announced on Wednesday.
They said the boards of the two banks had recommended the merger at separate meetings on April 13.
Both banks said that their boards had recommended that one CBO share should be equal to one Oman Savings share.
CBO proposed that its authorised share capital be increased to 50 million rials from 20 million to facilitate the merger.
Oman Savings said its board would recommend the liquidation of the company if the banks' shareholders agreed to the merger.
It is not clear what the new bank will be called.
Late last year Australia and New Zealand Banking Group sold its ANZ Grindlays branches in Oman to the then new Oman Savings and Finance Bank, which was listed earlier this year.
Oman Savings was trading on Wednesday at 2.74 rials. CBO was trading at 2.73 rials.
